claims.claim: The committed candidate changes only docs/CHATGPT_PROJECT_CONTRACT.md and introduces no new lifecycle, routing, retry, verification, review, publication, or planning authority.

Section 12 preserves canonical TASK-110 continuation and exact Publisher authority after semantic PASS, requires accepted dispatch to end the current Brain turn, and distinguishes acceptance from publication success.

The Brain Sync Protocol forbids same-turn publication polling after accepted dispatch and requires publication attention or explicit Human continuation to resume in a new turn beginning with fresh Brain Sync.
Both publication clauses permit current-turn diagnosis of immediate dispatch rejection or non-acceptance under existing fail-closed/manual-fallback authority.

The contract explicitly preserves all six specified local wake guards, requires no component or Flow Card changes, prohibits persistent publication-wait states, and denies canonical engineering truth to dispatch acceptance, turn termination, and wake delivery.
This implementation leaves RUN-303-004 and all TASK-303 lineage unchanged and performs no TASK-303 repair authoring or execution.
